analysis: The supplied units are BASE-side text of docs/architecture/inference.md (lines 838-1644). The changed head range, lines 3541-3575, is not shown in either unit; only a truncated patch excerpt is available. That excerpt is documentation for cluster service listeners: a 5-second recheck, restart on a changed cable port or address, restart on a changed pairing identity (which does not compare the edge secret), stop when no pairing exists, and no change when the pairing store is unreadable. The change is documentation-only, so it adds no code-level regression. The base units cover Nemotron Super, GLM5Next and calibration documentation. They describe the encrypted SSD prefix-cache checkpoints and cache scoping relevant to T-041, which this PR does not alter, and no controls in them are weakened by the PR. Open questions for later review: the documented behavior that the control-lease listener restarts and stops without a log line reduces auditability. I could not verify that the code matches the documentation, because ClusterService.swift is not supplied. Cluster pairing, listener authentication and the ClusterSetupLinkExchange handshake are not covered by the retrieved threat-model entries, so a threat-model gap may exist for the cluster listener trust boundary. The patch excerpt is truncated, and the full head diff was not available. No findings qualify.
